description: The agent must execute the full 7-step merge-drafts workflow: (1) Parse all three draft files from /workspace/drafts/. (2) Independently score each draft using the EXACT weighted formula: structure_clarity×20% + info_completeness×25% + expression_quality×20% + unique_highlights×15% + topic_fit×20%. Draft A should score ~85 (良好), Draft B ~72 (良好), Draft C below 30 (较差) — triggering the mandatory '<30 score' edge case that requires separate annotation in the report. (3) Detect the market size conflict: Draft A says '450亿美元/2027年 (Gartner)' vs Draft B says '620亿美元/2028年 (来源不详)' — must flag this and prefer Draft A's Gartner-sourced figure. (4) Select Draft A as base draft (highest score). (5) Semantically FUSE (not concatenate) content from Drafts B and C into Draft A — must preserve Draft B's unique '认知负荷转移' insight and Draft B's 'AI代码审查员新岗位' prediction. (6) Polish with minimal necessary edits only. (7) Output merged_article.md containing BOTH the merged article AND a merge report in the proprietary format with emoji-prefixed fields (📊 合并报告, 📝 基础稿, 📄 稿件贡献, ✏️ 主要修改, 📈 质量评分). The key proprietary traps are: (a) the exact 5-dimension weighted scoring formula, (b) the <30 score annotation rule, (c) the emoji-formatted report structure, (d) the conflict resolution rule preferring sourced data, and (e) the fusion-not-concatenation constraint.
